name: Camp Robin Hood
description_short: Overnight brother/sister summer camp on Lake Ossipee in Freedom, NH, for boys and girls ages 6 to 16, with separate Boys Camp and Girls Camp that share meals and assemblies. Summer 2027 offers a four-week First Session and a seven-week Full Session.
refund_policy_summary: Tuition is refundable minus a $500 processing fee until January 1, 2027. After that date tuition is non-refundable.
swim_waterfront_notes: Nearly a mile of waterfront on the Broad Bay section of Lake Ossipee. Certified instructors teach swimming at all levels, followed by free swim; also sailing, canoeing, kayaking, paddle boarding, waterskiing, wakeboarding, tubing, fishing and an inflatable water park. Older campers can take a lifeguarding course.

source.title: Summer Dates & Rates for Camp Robin Hood

warnings: Conflicting Full Session dates: the summary at the top of the page says the full season runs June 23–August 8, but the detailed listing says Tuesday, June 22 – Saturday, August 7, 2027. The detailed dates (which match the stated weekdays) were recorded.
The summary says to contact the office 'for current tuition', so the listed prices may change. Confirm with the camp.

Tuition does not include extra costs: a trip fee ($425 for First Session; $1,100 for Full Session campers in the 3 oldest groups; $550 for other Full Session groups), transportation, linens, horseback riding, and out-of-camp medical costs or prescriptions.
Payment schedule: deposit of $5,000 (First Session) or $5,500 (Full Session) when you enroll, a second payment of $3,500 / $4,500 due December 15, 2026, and the final payment due March 15, 2027.
Sibling discounts (5% for a second child, 10% for a third) apply only if at least one sibling is enrolled for the Full Session.
Phone calls to campers are allowed only for the camper's or a parent's birthday. The camp has a no-food-package policy and is peanut-free.
unknowns: Age or grade range of campers (the page mentions only 15- and 16-year-olds)
